brief: The power conduits need to be rerouted to activate the gate.
detailed: Check the power console in the gate room. The conduits are labeled — try matching them to the gate symbols above.
full_solution: Press the console buttons in this order: 3, 1, 4, 2. The gate will activate once all conduits are aligned.

brief: The oxygen scrubbers need to be restarted.
detailed: Find the life support console. Each scrubber must be activated in sequence — start with the one closest to the door.
full_solution: Activate scrubbers in order: North, East, South, West. The console shows their positions on a map.

brief: The bridge console needs the correct destination code.
detailed: Rush mentioned the address symbols. Check your quest log for the symbol sequence.
full_solution: Enter the symbols: 3-7-5-2-8. Confirm by pressing the central dial.
